entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?

Thank you. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 19th. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works fine. I've just... I've changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and honestly, I just don't use it like I thought I would. I feel a bit guilty about spending the money.

I understand completely. Sometimes a new gadget doesn't fit into our routine the way we expect. I'm looking at our policy for the VeloBand Pulse, and I see that it has a specific 10-day return window. Since your order was delivered 18 days ago, we are unfortunately past that period for a full refund.
Oh. Ten days? I thought it was longer. I've been a loyal customer for a while and was really counting on getting that money back. I... I really needed this.

I truly do apologize, and I wish there were an exception I could make. The 10-day policy is in place for hygiene reasons and because the device activation links it permanently to a user account. However, since a return isn't an option, I do have a great alternative solution that many of our customers use in this exact situation.

We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform where you can sell your device directly to another member of the VeloFit community. Since you mentioned you don't use it, it's likely in perfect condition, and you could get a very good price for it—often very close to what you originally paid.
A resale site? Hmm. Is it complicated? I've never done that before.

Not at all. We've made it very simple. It's a trusted environment just for VeloFit users, so you know you're dealing with fellow enthusiasts. It's the best way to recoup the cost of an impulse buy like this. I can email you the direct link and a simple guide on how to create a listing.
Okay... I guess that's better than being stuck with it. If I can get most of my money back, that would really help. Yes, please send me that link.

Absolutely. I've just sent that email to the address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. I'm glad we found a good path forward for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
